description: Resolve. Call this when you hold words, not a barcode: a shopper's phrase ("the big jar of Nutella") or a merchant's offer line, and a country. Returns one barcode (Global Trade Item Number, GTIN) with a confidence when the record holds exactly one product for the words, otherwise the candidates, otherwise unknown. Never a guess. This is the matcher at matchfetch.ai, answered here under its own name; issue_receipt: true writes a signed receipt. Once you hold the barcode, call fetch_gtin to verify it.

country.description: two-letter country, e.g. UK, FR, DE, US

words.description: the phrase or the offer line

name: match_product
title: Resolve: words to a barcode
